• Earlier screenshots preserve the original saved-data-only inspection. The user subsequently authorized live microphone, import, Q&A and review capture
• Every screen image is an unmodified physical-phone capture; offline, unavailable and processing states are retained.
• New rehearsal and Q&A audio were recorded through the phone microphone from agent-operated synthetic speech played acoustically. This is a
demonstration, not a human usability test.
• Visible provider transcripts, coaching, question and score results are actual runtime responses; intermediate pending states are labeled separately.
• The first demo transcript used the original local service. The exact saved take and media were then carried to an isolated backend to recover a
persistent HTTP connection; its 110 backend source modules match PR31 and it served the later demo AI responses.
• The installed bundle's 112 imported application modules match PR31; the retained source map is local build evidence, not a signed Git identifier.
• A captured route does not establish every conditional, failure, or destructive path. The earlier source board retains the full source inventory.
• The phone was left on the new demo Full Review after Keep current preserved the original 75-second demo run; existing personal presentations were
• upload: The genuine native PDF import succeeded and its setup is captured. The brief analysis state before setup passed before a distinct screenshot
• qa: Generated questions, live answer recording, evaluation and the offered follow-up are captured. A separate follow-up answer and archive were not
• conditional states: All seven app routes are represented. Destructive choices, exhaustive error recovery and every conditional correction or editing
panel were not exercised; the source wireframe board inventories the broader state space.
Screenshots are actual captures. Source navigation does not certify that every action or provider operation completed. Earlier source wireframes are
